## Verdict

wrong

## Bearer

ProfileSyncPushService — core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/sync/ProfileSyncPushService.kt

## Trigger

`onMessageReceived`, in ProfileSyncListenerService (app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/sync/ProfileSyncListenerService.kt) — observed

## Today

`onMessageReceived` computes `raceInProgress` synchronously, by calling
`raceRecordingRepository.findInProgress()`, at the instant the push
message arrives, then launches a coroutine on `serviceScope` that runs
`applyIncoming` later, passing that boolean along. `applyIncoming`
(ProfileSyncPushService.kt) does not query race status itself: it only
reads the `raceInProgress` parameter it was handed, and returns
`Refused` — applying nothing — when it is true. A race that starts
between the moment the message is received and the moment the
coroutine actually runs is invisible to `applyIncoming`: it still
receives the stale `false` and proceeds to call
`raceRepository.replaceReference`, `watchHistoryStore.replaceAll` and
`applyProfile`, replacing the watch's whole state while a race is
running.

## Expected

`applyIncoming` determines whether a race is in progress itself,
immediately before deciding to apply or refuse the payload, instead of
trusting a `raceInProgress` value computed by its caller earlier. The
decision and the check that drives it happen at the same point in
time, so a race that starts after the message is received but before
`applyIncoming` runs is still caught.

Second gap: making the check happen inside `applyIncoming` requires
`ProfileSyncPushService` to reach a race-in-progress query at the
moment it acts — `RaceRecordingRepository.findInProgress()` is the only
one that exists (core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/race/RaceRecordingRepository.kt),
but its sole implementation, `RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl`, lives in
`:app-wear` (app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/RaceRecordingRepositoryImpl.kt).
`ProfileSyncPushService` is constructed identically on both sides —
`:app-wear`'s `SyncModule` and `:app-phone`'s `SyncModule` both call
`ProfileSyncPushService(profileRepository, raceRepository,
watchHistoryStore, transport)` — and `:app-phone`'s DI graph provides
no binding for `RaceRecordingRepository` at all, since the phone never
records a race live. Adding that dependency to
`ProfileSyncPushService`'s constructor leaves `:app-phone`'s
`SyncModule` (app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/di/SyncModule.kt)
unable to supply it.
